specs.title: share.dialog.open: Share in the title row opens the dialog with the View, Present and Edit links
share.copy-view-link: Copy link on the View link row copies a link that opens /deck/<id> as a viewer (the copied address is <origin>/s/<token>)
share.copy-present-link: Copy link on the Present link row copies a link that opens /deck/<id>?present=1 as a viewer (the copied address is <origin>/s/<token>?present=1)
share.copy-edit-link: Copy link on the Edit link row copies a link that opens /edit/<id> as an editor (the copied address is <origin>/s/<token>)
share.file-menu-copy-link: File > Share > Copy link copies the view address
share.view-link-lands-viewer: A second browser on the View link lands on the read only viewer with no editor chrome
share.edit-link-lands-editor: A third browser on the Edit link lands in the editor
share.view-link-cannot-edit: A browser that arrived by the View link and changes /deck/ to /edit/ cannot edit the deck
